text.en: The sitio of Balite in the barrio of Banoyo Municipality of San Luis, Province of Batangas, is hereby separated from the said barrio and converted into a new barrio to be known as the barrio of Balite.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
